episodes.title: The Magician's Assistant
episodes.summary: Terry begrudgingly welcomes Conan O'Brien to the force and works a magic show murder case involving a rival, a former assistant and a moms' association.

episodes.title: Triplet Homicide
episodes.summary: As Terry mourns his late great-aunt, he finds support in trainee Marshawn Lynch, who helps him scope out suspects after a wealthy woman is killed.

episodes.title: Most Likely to Commit Murder
episodes.summary: Working the night shift, Terry is paired with detective-in-training Kumail Nanjiani and heads back to high school to investigate a tech CEO's death.

episodes.title: Murder by Soup
episodes.summary: When a chief health inspector is found dead by poisoning, Terry and Annie Murphy get their hands dirty as they look for leads in a menu of suspects.

episodes.title: Heartless
episodes.summary: After a doctor flatlines at the hospital, Terry and Sharon Stone tackle a medical murder mystery where they must question staff and sew up loose ends.

episodes.title: The Cold Case
episodes.summary: After a big break in a cold case, the investigation heats up for Terry and Ken Jeong, as they resort to truly desperate measures to catch a killer.
